build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance with a PyTorch model, logger, tokenizer, and config namespace
run_Trainer_train: run the training loop on a data loader with optional eval-only mode and split name
run_Trainer_eval: run the evaluation loop on a validation data loader with no gradient computation
run_Trainer_generate: run text generation on a batch to produce answer tokens from context and question
review_Trainer_is_stopping_criteria: review the early stopping logic based on validation metric patience and distributed broadcast
